purpose: Replace the type-only label for the shared Type-0x62/0x63 player-collision settling path.

promotion.name: PlayerCollision_SettleType62Response

contract.dispatch: Shared player-collision entry for actor types 0x62 and 0x63
contract.eligibility: Requires eligible terrain response and actor collision flag bit 0x10
contract.settling: Snaps PLAYER_Y to actor Y minus WORLD_CAMERA_Y within a 10-pixel window
contract.transition: Promotes Type-0x62 to Type-0x63, installs ACTOR_MOVE_TYPE62_63_PLAYER_COLLISION_RESPONSE, and optionally queues audio command 0x45
contract.rejection: Raises the collision-response suppress flag when the contact cannot settle

evidence: Direct terrain/actor-flag eligibility and 10-pixel Y-window comparison
Direct Type-0x63 promotion, movement-root, audio, and suppress-flag writes

conclusion: The promoted name identifies the Type-0x62 to Type-0x63 settling transition while retaining the shared dispatch-type alias.
